newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan stocks seen up on pre-budget rally.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan stocks seen up on pre-budget rally.

text.p: Pakistan stocks are likely to gain further on Tuesday in a pre-budget rally, but dealers said weak fundamentals would drag down the index soon.

"This rally was due because the index had slipped to attractive levels," dealer Dawar Hasan said. "But these gains are unlikely to be sustained for long because Pakistan's economic outlook remains weak."
On Monday, the index rose 41.35 points, or 2.70 percent, to end at 1,572.12. Gainers led losers 229 to 66. Turnover rose to 44.46 million shares from 15.66 million in previous session.
